upload.note: PyPI releases 1.26.1 and 1.26.2. Pinning and lockfile review are the control. The publish itself is off-host.

pth-hook.note: Linux file creation of a .pth under site-packages. The Elastic rule is Linux-only. Windows and macOS interpreters are a gap.

collect.note: Environment secrets, credential files, and cloud identity token requests, including OpenAI, Hugging Face, and Foundry names.

webhook.note: Single HTTPS POST to webhook.site. The free-tier host is shared with legitimate debugging.
